about: REQUEST FOR MUSE (data job, not code). The Admit Power score compares a student's unweighted GPA to a per-school 'typical admitted GPA'. Today that number (typicalGpa in index.html) is an ESTIMATE from admit rate and SAT range, not real data. Please add real admitted-student GPA where it is published, so the app can use it and fall back to the estimate only when missing.
source: Each school's Common Data Set, section C (C11 average high-school GPA of enrolled first-years; C12 GPA distribution bands; C7 'GPA' importance). Use the most recent published year. Record the year.

fields_per_school.gpaAvg: C11 average GPA, number or null
fields_per_school.gpaScale: 'unweighted' | 'weighted' | 'unknown' (CDS C11 doesn't say; note if the school's own page does)
fields_per_school.cdsUrl: link to the CDS file used

then: every school with admit rate between 40% and 95% (about 1,200 in the catalog), then the rest.
caveats: Many CDS GPAs are weighted or self-reported; flag gpaScale honestly rather than guessing.
Do not convert weighted to unweighted without saying so.
Leave null where unpublished; the app keeps its estimate there.
why_now: The app's estimate averages 3.30 for 50-70% admit-rate schools and 3.17 for 70-90%. Published CDS averages at such schools are often higher, so the estimate may be too LOW, not too high. This can't be settled without real data.
